main_text.p: Communes quæ sunt toti sanctitati communes . Harum & aliarum omnium cuiusq; generis partium quædam ex singulari modo ad hominum necessitates accommodatè καθ' ἐξοχὴν πίσται & excellentes sunt & dicuntur. Psal. 19. 17. & 120. 1. 1.Tim.3.1. 1.Tim.1.15.
main_text.l: Prima omnes affectiones & habitus, quæ in malum & ad bonum feruntur magis intendantur.
Secunda malorum media omnia vitentur, bonorum autem exercentur impensius.
De medijs hinc oriuntur leges duæ,
main_text.p: De appendicibus lex est vt legis(a)cuiusq; appendices,(etsi de rebus no ita magnis)quæ nos instruat & adiuuant ad hoc officiu, seruandæ sint.(a)1.Cor. 9.9.Deut.25.4.Mand.4.
De temperantia leges {cibis & exercitijs: speciales sunt de {apparatu. Eccles.10.13.15.16.cum Tit.2.3.Rom.13 13.
De vtrisq; autem communis est vt facultati & vocationi cuiusq; exequantur. ibid. 1.Tim. 3.2. 2.Sam.13.18.
De cibis leges sunt, vt tempestiuè & sobriè recipiantur, ita vt homo totus robore magis ad bonum valeat

page.notes: The brace diagram is transcribed as outline lines; the facing right page is cropped to fragments and only the fragments are legible. Several marginal words of the facing page are illegible and not transcribed. Greek in the text ("καθ' ἐξοχὴν πίσται") is a best reading of the scan, marked as uncertain: καθ' ἐξοχὴν πίστει. The left-hand block of "Leges" lines is a brace diagram and should be read as such.
